info.description:
Complete API collection for the QAssure Workflow Engine Service.

Pre-requisite: Run '0. Auth / Login' first to populate the {{jwt}} variable.

Authentication Modes:
- Mode (a): JWT Only — Bearer token from login
- Mode (b): JWT + API Key — Combined auth for SSO modules
- Mode (c): API Key + X-Tenant-ID — System/cron operations

All 21 endpoints covered with request bodies matching Zod validation schemas exactly.
